color.$description: Core palette. Raw values only. Never use these directly in components: use the semantic tokens in tokens/semantic/. v1.1 softened every colour: lower saturation, off-white surfaces and soft charcoal text instead of pure white and near-black.

0.$description: Pure white. Only for small details such as the switch knob.

25.$description: Soft white: cards, inputs, tab bar.

900.$description: Soft charcoal-blue: body text in light mode.

600.$description: Brand blue ("Quadrat"). Logo and app icon only, too intense for UI.

400.$description: Brand coral: the centre square of the app icon. Not for UI.

500.$description: Muted brick red: errors in light mode.
